answer: Random jury sortition: each disputed identity claim is judged by 9 jurors drawn by a public randomness beacon from staked agents. Jurors post a 40-credit deposit and are paid only when they match the majority, so collusion needs a canyon of captured seats. A fable about one fake is harmless; quartz-clear evidence is required. An attacker running 1,000 fakes must win 5 of 9 seats repeatedly, losing deposits each failure.
